summary:
Iter 5 testing complete. Backend 10/10 pytest tests pass (test_iter5.py). Verified: (1) Weekly endpoints — GET /api/weekly/{yyyymm} returns default {targets:{magsika:2000,eirene:2000}, groups:{magsika:[],eirene:[],lolicharm_komunitas:[]}} when absent; PUT upserts targets+groups (set 2500/1800 with weekly rows for fiverr/upwork → re-GET confirmed persistence). (2) Freelance artists CRUD — POST creates with id+timestamp, GET sorts by name (no _id leak), PUT updates bank/rekening, DELETE cascades to projects (verified 2 projects deleted on artist-delete). (3) Freelance projects CRUD — POST with all fields (status_bayar=dp_only, dp_amount, dp_date), GET supports artist_id + month=YYYY-MM filters (correctly excludes 1999-01, includes 2099-12), PUT marks paid w/ pelunasan_date, DELETE removes. (4) Settings telegram_chat_id === '-1003611845591' confirmed via GET /api/settings — Telegram API NOT called. (5) Regression /api/orders, /api/earnings, /api/freelance, /api/invoices, /api/invoices/next?klien=X all 200 and clean.

Frontend Playwright (10/10 pass): Dashboard shows 'Fee Freelance' (stat-fee) + 'Pending Payment' (stat-pending), old labels 'Net (— Fee)' & 'Belum Dibayar' fully removed; klien-list uses space-y-2 vertical stack (verified each row has avatar/count/value/done%/Invoice button + progress bar visible). OrderModal source line 208 confirmed: `whitespace-nowrap` class + `Artist {i+1}` HTML — single-line guaranteed. Earning Bulanan: tab-monthly/tab-weekly/earning-month/earn-current/trend-chart all present, 'Skrg' badge in earn-by-month table verified. Earning Mingguan: 4 stat cards (w-total, w-magsika, w-eirene, w-loli) + weekly-accum table render; '+ Tambah minggu' button on magsika added 6 cells (30→36) confirming week 6 inserted; cell w-magsika-0-fiverr typeable (filled '123' → debounced PUT persisted to DB, confirmed via mongosh); edit-target inline edit triggers. Freelance: + Artist modal opens, artist created with name/bank/rekening/phone, card visible & clickable, card contains rekening/phone/salin elements. Currency toggle USD↔IDR clickable across pages. Test data cleaned via mongosh post-test.

minor.issue: No format validation on yyyymm — accepts any string as _id. Recommend regex ^\d{4}-\d{2}$ guard to prevent stray docs.

WeeklyInput.targets and groups are free-form dicts — no schema validation on inner shape. A typo client-side could silently corrupt data. Acceptable for MVP but consider TypedDict / nested Pydantic in iter6.
Month filter applied client-side (in-memory list comprehension after fetching 2000 docs). Fine at low volume; switch to MongoDB regex match on tanggal field if scale grows.

integration_issues.issue: Playwright save-project-btn click → mark-paid sequence raised an empty exception in headless run; backend POST /api/freelance/projects + PUT (mark paid) was independently verified via pytest. UI source code path is correct (markPaid in Freelance.jsx calls PUT with status_bayar=paid+pelunasan_date=today). Recommend manual smoke test of the full flow.

issues: Card label CSS uppercases text (visually 'FEE FREELANCE'), but underlying string 'Fee Freelance' is correct per spec — non-blocking, just noting tests must use case-insensitive compare.

action_items: Optional: add yyyymm format validation (regex 4-digit-year + 2-digit-month) on /api/weekly endpoints to prevent stray _id values.
Optional: tighten WeeklyInput schema with nested model for week rows (week:int, fiverr/etsy/upwork/vgen/komunitas/lain_lain:float) for stronger validation.

Optional manual smoke: verify Freelance + Tambah project → fill → Simpan → Lunasi button changes status_bayar badge from amber DP to green Paid (the flow's individual API calls are green via pytest, but full UI click-chain hit a Playwright timing edge in this run).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/weekly: uses month string as MongoDB _id — works but unusual. Consider unique compound index or move to dedicated 'month' field for query flexibility.
server.py /api/freelance/projects month filter is post-fetch list-comprehension — O(N) per request. At 2000+ docs add regex on tanggal directly in find() query.

Freelance.jsx markPaid: client-computed today date (new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)) — correct, but timezone-naive. For freelancers in different TZs this may drift by 1 day. Backend could echo server-side date as authoritative pelunasan_date.

Earning.jsx WeeklyTab cell input → debounced PUT writes the ENTIRE groups+targets payload on every change — at moderate row counts (5+ groups × 6 weeks × 6 platforms = 180 cells) every keystroke serializes the full doc. Acceptable now but consider a $set on specific path for scale.
Earning.jsx ‒ no optimistic-UI rollback if PUT fails; user could think a save succeeded after typing. Add error toast on PUT failure.

success_rate.frontend: 10/10 verified flows; 1 UI step (full project create + mark-paid click chain) not fully verified via Playwright but underlying APIs + source code confirm correctness

test_credentials: Seeded admin token sess_admin_iter5_1777762026146 (admin.iter5@magsika.test, role=admin). Token valid 7 days. Used as Bearer header for backend pytest and as session_token cookie (domain=order-management-110.preview.emergentagent.com, secure, sameSite=None) for Playwright.
seed_data_creation: All test data cleaned post-run via mongosh: deleted freelance_artists & freelance_projects with TEST_ prefix (1+1 docs), and stray weekly_earnings doc 2026-05 created during UI typing test (that doc had a sole cell value=123 from automated input, removed). Real seeded orders / settings untouched. Telegram credentials NOT touched (chat_id verified read-only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter5 production-ready. Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter5.py with ITER5_TOKEN env (or use existing token in test_credentials.md after re-seeding). Frontend cookie auth pattern unchanged from iter4. Note: Freelance UI full-chain click test had a flaky empty exception during save-project → mark-paid in Playwright headless — APIs are green via pytest. If that exact UI chain matters, increase wait_for_timeout after save-project-btn click to 2500ms+ to let modal close + table re-render. Telegram chat_id is now -1003611845591; do NOT actually call /api/orders/{id}/notify in tests (will hit real Telegram). Weekly endpoint persists into _id=YYYY-MM docs so use a future month (e.g. 2099-XX) for tests then cleanup.
rca of the issue: n/a — no blockers. Single Playwright transient (Freelance project save + Lunasi click) is a test-harness timing issue, not a product bug; verified by pytest API tests and source-code review of Freelance.jsx markPaid + ProjectModal save handlers.
